title: Fairness Under Unawareness: Assessing Disparity When Protected Class Is Unobserved
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical and mathematical derivation of bias in estimators for demographic disparity (fairness) in decision-making systems. While fairness is an ethical concept, the paper does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks; instead, it treats fairness as a statistical and legal requirement for algorithmic compliance.
